track: Secondary official-weights adaptation; fixed before reading either exam
exposure: Each of the identical 2048 stored layouts with both wirings, clutches and probes exactly once, shuffled in the same order and paired with exactly the same training goal for both methods; not identical budget to 4096-update scratch arms.
public_input: Only archived base and probe brightness grids (packed as R=5*base, G=5*peak, B=.5+3*delta, clipped to [0,1]), 18 public instrument channels, four-address goal. English instructions serialize the same goal; no captions or extra trajectories.

smol.policy: Strict official model load, native visual/text trunk and flow action expert. Cache frozen visual tokens if useful; deterministically serialize public goals and include the same card as proprioceptive input. Tune state/output projections and last expert layer. One 128x128 sensor view, chunk 1, four Euler steps from zero, one active signed axis.

dino.policy: Frozen DINOv2-S/14 at 56x56; unmodified author ViTPredictor, 16 patches, 2 blocks, learned sensor/actuator conditioning. The stored targets are 12 optical displacements, not future RGB/DINO features. Learned goal readout selects between both one-step candidates; a DINO-WM adaptation, not the authors' benchmark/checkpoint.

both: Train probe from initial view and resting side. Report paired and individual closed-loop task success on both panels with layout CIs. One transfer seed; no intervention, no three-seed claims. Separate hyperparameters and wall time. Do not select checkpoints on evaluation.
